workflows.title: Inspect and organize a project safely
workflows.mutationBoundary: Planning is local and review-only; any later Premiere mutation has its own capability, confirmation, and readback contract.

workflows.title: Build a transcript-backed rough-cut proposal
workflows.mutationBoundary: Context packs and plans never transcribe, call an AI provider, or remove timeline media.

workflows.title: Import and structurally review captions
workflows.mutationBoundary: Caption-track readback is structural acceptance only; playback, readability, and render verification remain separate.

workflows.title: Prepare and verify a delivery
workflows.mutationBoundary: An export request, file check, and quality review establish different evidence levels and do not publish a delivery.

verification.automated: Tests and generated catalogs prove package behavior, schemas, routing, bounds, and documented readback contracts.
verification.host: A real supported Premiere host is required to establish host behavior; this manifest contains no licensed-host claim.
verification.playbackAndRender: Structural readback does not establish playback, visual quality, audio quality, caption readability, or final render quality.

proofKit.note: No walkthrough video or licensed-host receipt is claimed until a fixture-only run is recorded and reviewed.

communityCoverage.note: External reports are historical user experiences, not current compatibility or support claims.
